titleEn: Length of the Longest Valid Substring
title: 最长合法子字符串的长度
summary: 给定单词与禁用字符串列表，求不包含任何禁用字符串作为连续片段的最长子字符串长度。
insight: 禁用串长度最多十。枚举右端点时，只需检查以它结尾的至多十个后缀；若发现禁用串，其起点必须被排除，把窗口左端移到起点后一位。按起点从大到小检查，首个命中给出最严格边界。
pitfalls: 禁用关系是连续子串而非子序列
只需检查长度不超过十的后缀
发现禁用串后左边界只能右移

solutions.title: 有限后缀检查滑动窗口
solutions.idea: 每个右端点检查所有可能以其结尾的禁用串。
steps: 把 forbidden 放入哈希集合
start 从 right 降到 max(left,right-9)
若 word[start..right] 禁用，left=start+1 并停止

code.java: class Solution { public int longestValidSubstring(String word,List<String> forbidden){Set<String> banned=new HashSet<>(forbidden);int left=0,answer=0;for(int right=0;right<word.length();right++){for(int start=right;start>=Math.max(left,right-9);start--)if(banned.contains(word.substring(start,right+1))){left=start+1;break;}answer=Math.max(answer,right-left+1);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun longestValidSubstring(word:String,forbidden:List<String>):Int{val banned=forbidden.toHashSet();var left=0;var answer=0;for(right in word.indices){for(start in right downTo maxOf(left,right-9))if(word.substring(start,right+1) in banned){left=start+1;break};answer=maxOf(answer,right-left+1)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int longestValidSubstring(string word,vector<string>& forbidden){unordered_set<string> banned(forbidden.begin(),forbidden.end());int left=0,answer=0;for(int right=0;right<(int)word.size();++right){for(int start=right;start>=max(left,right-9);--start)if(banned.count(word.substr(start,right-start+1))){left=start+1;break;}answer=max(answer,right-left+1);}return answer;} };
